title: Proposition 8.10: cancellation of finite presentation to order n along a composite
statement_scope: Suppose given maps f:A -> B and g:B -> C of connective E∞-rings. Assume that f is of finite presentation to order n. Then g is of finite presentation to order n if and only if the composite g∘f is of finite presentation to order n. Whole proposition, both directions.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: the proposition proves cancellation of finite presentation to order n along a composite by combining the π0 finite-presentation criterion with the cotangent fiber sequence C⊗_B L_{B/A} -> L_{C/A} -> L_{C/B} and Remark VIII.2.6.8 (statement and proof page 42). Non-routine but a supporting cancellation result.
